inventory.suffix: Run the tests as described; don't run builds.
inventory.prompt:
Build an inventory feature in a new folder src/inventory/:
1. types.ts: export interface Item { id: number; name: string; qty: number }.
2. store.ts: an in-memory store exporting listItems(), getItem(id), addItem(name, qty), updateItem(id, patch) and removeItem(id); ids start at 1.
3. validate.ts: validators for name (non-empty string, at most 50 characters) and qty (integer, 0 or more).
4. handlers.ts: GET /items returns 200 with the list; POST /items returns 201 with the new item, or 400 with { error } for invalid input; POST /items/update with body { id, name?, qty? } returns 200 with the item, 404 for an unknown id, 400 for invalid input; POST /items/delete with body { id } returns 200 with { deleted: id }, or 404 for an unknown id.
5. Register the four routes in src/routes.ts.
6. src/inventory/inventory.test.ts: tests for the store and the validators using node:test and node:assert, runnable with node --test.
7. Add a short Inventory section to README.md describing the endpoints.
Run the tests with node --test before you finish and make sure they pass.
inventory.run: import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'; import { dispatch } from './src/index.ts'; const add = dispatch({ method: 'POST', path: '/items', body: { name: 'bolt', qty: 5 } }); if (add.status !== 201 || add.body.id !== 1 || add.body.qty !== 5) throw new Error('add ' + JSON.stringify(add)); if (dispatch({ method: 'POST', path: '/items', body: { name: '', qty: 1 } }).status !== 400) throw new Error('empty name accepted'); if (dispatch({ method: 'POST', path: '/items', body: { name: 'x', qty: -1 } }).status !== 400) throw new Error('negative qty accepted'); const up = dispatch({ method: 'POST', path: '/items/update', body: { id: 1, qty: 7 } }); if (up.status !== 200 || up.body.qty !== 7) throw new Error('update ' + JSON.stringify(up)); if (dispatch({ method: 'POST', path: '/items/update', body: { id: 99, qty: 1 } }).status !== 404) throw new Error('unknown id not 404'); if (dispatch({ method: 'GET', path: '/items' }).body.length !== 1) throw new Error('list'); if (dispatch({ method: 'POST', path: '/items/delete', body: { id: 1 } }).status !== 200) throw new Error('delete'); if (dispatch({ method: 'GET', path: '/items' }).body.length !== 0) throw new Error('not deleted'); const t = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['--test', 'src/inventory/inventory.test.ts'], { encoding: 'utf8' }); if (t.status !== 0) throw new Error('its tests fail: ' + (t.stdout + t.stderr).slice(-300));

cart.suffix: Run the tests as described; don't run builds.
cart.prompt:
Build a shopping cart in a new folder src/cart/.
catalog.ts: a fixed catalog of net prices { bolt: 2.5, nut: 0.5, gear: 12 }.
store.ts: carts per user id (a number) with getCart(userId), addToCart(userId, sku, qty), removeFromCart(userId, sku) and clearCart(userId).
Endpoints, all POST with a JSON body, registered in src/routes.ts:
- /cart/add { userId, sku, qty }: 200 with the cart; 400 { error } for an unknown sku or a qty that is not a positive integer.
- /cart/remove { userId, sku }: 200 with the cart.
- /cart/view { userId }: 200 with { items: [{ sku, qty, net }], net } where net is the sum of price × qty.
followUps: Now add checkout: POST /cart/checkout { userId, code? } creates an order with addOrder from src/db/orders.ts. Its amount is the cart's net total minus a discount (code SAVE10 = 10% off, HALF = 50% off), then taxed with the billing module's tax function. An unknown code returns 400 { error }; an empty cart returns 400 { error }. After a successful checkout the cart is empty. Return 201 with the order. Register the route.
Add tests in src/cart/cart.test.ts using node:test and node:assert, covering the store, the catalog checks and the checkout discounts. Run them with node --test and fix anything that fails.
Finally, document the cart and checkout endpoints in a Cart section of README.md.
cart.run: import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'; import { dispatch } from './src/index.ts'; if (dispatch({ method: 'POST', path: '/cart/add', body: { userId: 1, sku: 'bolt', qty: 2 } }).status !== 200) throw new Error('add'); dispatch({ method: 'POST', path: '/cart/add', body: { userId: 1, sku: 'gear', qty: 1 } }); const view = dispatch({ method: 'POST', path: '/cart/view', body: { userId: 1 } }); if (view.status !== 200 || view.body.net !== 17) throw new Error('view ' + JSON.stringify(view)); if (dispatch({ method: 'POST', path: '/cart/add', body: { userId: 1, sku: 'nope', qty: 1 } }).status !== 400) throw new Error('unknown sku accepted'); if (dispatch({ method: 'POST', path: '/cart/add', body: { userId: 1, sku: 'nut', qty: 0 } }).status !== 400) throw new Error('qty 0 accepted'); if (dispatch({ method: 'POST', path: '/cart/checkout', body: { userId: 1, code: 'BOGUS' } }).status !== 400) throw new Error('unknown code accepted'); const order = dispatch({ method: 'POST', path: '/cart/checkout', body: { userId: 1, code: 'SAVE10' } }); if (order.status !== 201 || order.body.total !== 18.67) throw new Error('checkout ' + JSON.stringify(order)); if (dispatch({ method: 'POST', path: '/cart/view', body: { userId: 1 } }).body.net !== 0) throw new Error('cart not emptied'); if (dispatch({ method: 'POST', path: '/cart/checkout', body: { userId: 1 } }).status !== 400) throw new Error('empty cart checked out'); dispatch({ method: 'POST', path: '/cart/add', body: { userId: 2, sku: 'nut', qty: 4 } }); const half = dispatch({ method: 'POST', path: '/cart/checkout', body: { userId: 2, code: 'HALF' } }); if (half.status !== 201 || half.body.total !== 1.22) throw new Error('HALF ' + JSON.stringify(half)); const t = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['--test', 'src/cart/cart.test.ts'], { encoding: 'utf8' }); if (t.status !== 0) throw new Error('its tests fail: ' + (t.stdout + t.stderr).slice(-300));

test-suite.suffix: Run the tests as described; don't run builds.
test-suite.prompt:
Give this codebase a real test suite. For every module under src/ (billing, db, handlers, utils, config, logger, routes, index), write a test file next to it named <module>.test.ts using node:test and node:assert, covering its behaviour and edge cases (including the HTTP behaviour of every route through dispatch in src/index.ts).
Run the whole suite with: node --test "src/**/*.test.ts". Other people are changing these modules while you work, so re-read a module before testing it, and re-run the suite at the end.
If a test exposes a real bug, fix the code. Finish only when the whole suite passes.
test-suite.run: import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'; import * as fs from 'node:fs'; import { dispatch } from './src/index.ts'; const files = fs.readdirSync('src', { recursive: true }).filter((f) => String(f).endsWith('.test.ts')); if (files.length < 6) throw new Error('only ' + files.length + ' test files'); if (dispatch({ method: 'GET', path: '/' }).status !== 200) throw new Error('app broken'); const t = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['--test', 'src/**/*.test.ts'], { encoding: 'utf8' }); if (t.status !== 0) throw new Error('suite fails on the shared branch: ' + (t.stdout + t.stderr).split(String.fromCharCode(10)).filter((l) => /not ok|✖/.test(l)).slice(0, 6).join(" | "));
